captions.caption_target_scope: Tissue expression of ADAM[number masked] and GPNMB. ADAM[number masked] and GPNMB expression were evaluated by Multiple Tissue Expression array. The membrane, comprising polyA+ mRNA from different adult and fetal tissues, was hybridized with a [number masked]P labeled probe specific for the two genes and hybridization visualized by autoradiography. Bars represent the optical density evaluated for each dot.

In situ hybridization of human tissues. Shown are representative samples of medulloblastoma (A), brain metastasis of an adenocarcinoma (B) and Ewing sarcoma (C), hybridized with antisense probes for ADAM[number masked], GPNMB and PRSS[number masked], respectively. Positively stained blood vessels are indicated by arrows. Related hybridization with control sense probes for ADAM[number masked], GPNMB and PRSS[number masked] is shown in panel D-E-F. Normal brain samples, from different donors, hybridized respectively with antisense probes for ADAM[number masked] (G) and GPNMB (H) are shown. Alzheimer's-diseased brain hybridized with antisense probe for PRSS[number masked] is shown (I).
